Backend Developer (Node.js/NestJS) - Remote — Riolabz Technologies
We are looking for a passionate Backend Developer with strong experience in Node.js and NestJS to build scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.
Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js and NestJS
- Design and optimize database schemas and queries
- Integrate third-party APIs and payment gateways
- Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices
- Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code
- Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the development lifecycle
Requirements
- Strong knowledge of Node.js and NestJS
- Experience with MongoDB or PostgreSQL
- Good understanding of REST APIs and API security
- Experience with Git and version control
- Knowledge of JWT, OAuth, and authentication mechanisms
- Familiarity with Docker, AWS, or cloud deployment is an advantage
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills
